title: Confirmation lines use medium weight and grey as specified
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, active; [Part-B] = tracked part, set inactive.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WEIGHT A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WEIGHT-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WEIGHT-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WEIGHT A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WEIGHT B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WEIGHT-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WEIGHT-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WEIGHT B).
  5. Set [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-B], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] on the Active tab, [Part-B] on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [Part-A], pick "Inactive", click Save and look at the text of each line; click "Cancel" and close the dialog.
  2. On the Active tab turn on "Deactivate parts", tick [Part-A], click "Deactivate" and look at each line; click "Cancel" and × on the bar.
  3. On the Inactive tab turn on "Activate parts", tick [Part-B], click "Activate" and look at each line; click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 and 2: "Existing records that use it/them stay as they are." is medium weight (a little bolder than the other lines); "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." is grey; the part line or count line and "This part/These parts won't show up…" are regular weight in the normal dark text colour.
  • Step 3: "Existing records that use them stay as they are." is medium weight; "2 parts selected."/"1 part selected." and "These parts/This part can be added to new work again." are regular weight in the normal dark text colour.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R9, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3, 4.4 and 4.7. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
